history.text: Numidian kingdoms under Massinissa unified much of the north before Roman annexation.
Arab expansion brought Islam and Arabic across the Maghreb.
Algiers became an Ottoman regency and a major Mediterranean corsair port.
France invaded and began 132 years of colonial rule and settlement.
The war of independence ended French rule; independence came on 5 July 1962.
The civil war between the state and armed Islamist groups dominated the decade.

worthSeeing.title: Casbah of Algiers:
worthSeeing.text: The Ottoman-era citadel and medina above the bay, a UNESCO World Heritage site.

worthSeeing.title: Timgad:
worthSeeing.text: A Roman colonial town founded by Trajan around AD 100, preserved in the Aures highlands.

worthSeeing.title: Tassili n'Ajjer:
worthSeeing.text: Saharan rock art spanning thousands of years, among sandstone formations near Djanet.
